questions.question: ______ is a mandatory mark found on all processed fruit products sold in India – such as packaged fruit beverages, fruit-jams, crushes and squashes, pickles, dehydrated fruit products, and fruit extracts – as per the Food Safety and Standards Act of 2006.

questions.question: Which among the following Articles of the Constitution of India deals with the right to free and compulsory education of all children in the age group of 6-14 years?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Article __**21A.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 21A** **- Right to Education.**

 
 
• The **State shall provide free and compulsory education** to all** children of the age of six to fourteen years** in such manner as the State may, by law, determine.
 
• It comes** under Fundamental Rights(Part III) **of the constitution of India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Fundamental Rights are **mentioned between Article 12 to Article 35.**
 
• It was** borrowed from the US Constitution.**
 
• They are **Justiciable in nature,** which means we can move to the **High Court (Article 226)** and **Supreme Court(Article 32) **in case of **violation.**
 
• **Article 31A - **Saving of laws providing for the acquisition of estates, etc.
 
• **Article 101 -** Vacation of seats in Parliament.
 
• **Article 74 - **Council of Ministers to aid and advise President.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Other **important Articles** related to **Education:**

 
 
• **Article 30** **- Right of minorities** to **establish and administer educational institutions**. Like** Madarsa.**
 
• **Article 45 - **The **State shall provide free and compulsory education** for all children **until they complete the age of fourteen years.**
 
 
• **​**The **86th Amendment Act of 2002** changed the subject-matter of **Article 45** and made elementary education a **fundamental right under Article 21 A**.
 
• The amended directive requires the State to provide early childhood care and education for all children until they complete the age of six years.

questions.question: The ‘Gandhara’ School of Art was influenced by the art from which of the following European countries?
questions.solution:

__
 
• **Gandhara art**, a style of Buddhist visual art that developed in what is now northwestern Pakistan and eastern Afghanistan between the 1st century BCE and the 7th century CE.
 
• The style, of **Greco-Roman origin,** seems to have flourished largely during the Kushan dynasty and was contemporaneous with an important but dissimilar school of Kushan art at Mathura (Uttar Pradesh, India).
 
• The Gandhara school incorporated many motifs and techniques from classical Roman art, including vine scrolls, cherubs bearing garlands, tritons, and centaurs. The basic iconography, however, remained Indian.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Greece is bordered to the east by the Aegean sea, to the south by the mediterranean sea, and to the west by the Ionian Sea.
 
 
 
• **Italy**, a country of south-central Europe, occupying a peninsula that juts deep into the mediterranean sea.
 
 
• The capital is Rome, one of the oldest of the world’s great cities.
 
 
 
• **Hungary**, Hungarian magyarország, landlocked country of central Europe.
 
 
• The capital is Budapest.
